# How to make an AI music video for your song with Claude Code

**Turn your song into a beat-synced AI music video: measured beat grid, approved stills, Seedance shots, lip sync and lyrics drawn in code.**

**Typical cost** with `varg-music-video`: ~$2.10 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 shot at 720p (estimate). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `kinetic-type-art`, `caption-styles`, `motion-formats`, `media-judge`.

**Short answer:** start with [`varg-music-video`](../../varg-music-video/README.md): direct it end to end: song map, concept, cast, storyboard on downbeats, Seedance shots, lip-sync pass, review rounds. The other 5 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-music-video --skill kinetic-type-art --skill caption-styles --skill motion-formats --skill kling-4-keyframe-film --skill media-judge
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a music video for my song ./track.wav with the lyrics in ./lyrics.txt. Anime look, one singer, cuts on the downbeats. Show me stills before any video."*

## Requests to paste into your agent

- "Make a music video for my song ./track.wav with the lyrics in ./lyrics.txt. Anime look, one singer, cuts on the downbeats. Show me stills before any video."
- "Make a kinetic typography lyric video for this song, 16:9 for YouTube, no AI footage."
- "I have no song yet. Write lyrics about leaving a small town, make a 2-minute indie-pop track at 98 BPM, then a music video for it."
- "Remake this music video idea with Kling 4 and my character sheet: ./singer.png"

## What you need

- The generation steps call the [varg API](https://varg.ai) (Seedance, Kling, Veo, GPT Image, ElevenLabs and more on one key). Sign in to the varg MCP with OAuth or set `VARG_API_KEY`. Models are billed at provider price, 1 credit = $0.01, and the agent shows an estimate before anything expensive.
- `varg-music-video`: ~$2.10 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 shot at 720p (estimate).
- `kling-4-keyframe-film`: ~$7.05 per 30 s take at 1080p; plan 2–4 takes per beat.
- Any agent that reads Agent Skills: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and others ([install options](../../README.md#install)).

## FAQ

### Can AI make a music video from my audio file?

Yes. varg-music-video starts from the WAV or MP3 and the lyric sheet: it splits stems (Demucs, run locally), fits a beat grid to the kick drum, gets word timings with Whisper on the vocal stem, and renders a timing proof you approve before any footage is made.

### How does the AI singer lip-sync?

The pipeline generates Seedance 2.5 shots and then runs a mandatory lip-sync pass on every singing shot.

### Can I make a lyric video without AI footage, for free?

Yes. motion-formats has a kinetic lyric video format and kinetic-type-art has lyric-style type; both render locally in HyperFrames or Remotion and spend no credits.

### I don't have a song yet. Can AI make one?

On varg, lyria_3_5 makes a full song with vocals up to about 3 minutes and eleven_music_v2_5 makes songs from 3 seconds to 10 minutes; many creators use Suno outside varg. State an exact BPM and structure in the prompt.

### Why approve stills first?

"Fix stills, not clips": a still costs a few credits, a clip tens to hundreds, and the video model keeps every fault in the still.

### Can I make the music video with Kling 4?

Yes, kling-4-keyframe-film covers music videos: key shots as stills, then one 30-second Kling 4 reference take per beat. The skill budgets a 30-second 1080p take at about 705 credits.
